quote.text: Don’t let the force of the impression when first it hits you knock you off your feet; just say to it, ‘Hold on a moment; let me see who you are and what you represent.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • When faced with a child's unexpected behavior or emotion, take a moment to understand its root rather than reacting impulsively, just as Epictetus advises discerning the impression before responding.
    • This reflective pause helps you teach your children the value of introspection and emotional regulation, fostering resilience and understanding in their everyday struggles.
  • Leadership
    • In leadership, unexpected challenges can unsettle even the most seasoned minds; thus, it's vital to assess the situation with calm deliberation before taking decisive action.
    • This deliberate approach not only preserves your own equilibrium but also sets a steady example for your team, encouraging a culture of thoughtful problem-solving and measured responses.
  • Product Management
    • When market feedback or technical issues hit suddenly, pause to evaluate the input objectively, ensuring that the initial shock does not derail your strategic vision.
    • Using this approach, you can integrate feedback constructively—distinguishing between transient noise and valuable insights—to drive continuous improvement and innovation in your product.
